source_rule: Wait for all20 original source execution outcomes and exact full-observed-history replay/account/program evidence. Never choose a completed subset, omit an aborted trial, resume missing rounds, replace a failed trial or select on returns.
library_rule: Union of every program actually consumed by a completed native feedback backtest in all20 original runs, irrespective of feedback acceptance or performance. Exact-expression duplicates may merge only after identical numerical columns are proved. Failed/unattempted rounds contribute no invented factor or return.
zero_program_rule: A verified run with no completed native backtest contributes an empty program set and remains explicitly represented. No per-trial portfolio/return is imputed. A wholly empty pooled set is not evaluable. A zero-program outcome requires its own exact terminal/source evidence; no generic unchecked empty manifest can pass.
causality_rule: Every contributed source-used program must pass nonvacuous aligned full-universe prefix and native-matrix proofs. Do not discard a failing program to obtain an evaluable subset.
additional_abort_rule: Any additional early/fatal outcome must be separately diagnosed, preserved and fully replayed before admission. It cannot pass merely because a scheduler job terminated.
